{{Top|leg}}
'''Rebel Combat Training Facilities''' were training facilities for various Rebel Alliance starfighter pilots. They did simulations based on previous missions.

[[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] had participated in several of these simulations, having personally completed 18 of them.
